name: National Technology Data Center Park / Centro Nacional de Dados (Alto Bandim, Bissau)
developer: UNDP Guinea-Bissau (implementer); Government of Guinea-Bissau (owner); Japan (funder)
notes: UNDP tender UNDP-GNB-00270 'Construction of National Technology Data Center Park', UNGM notice 278362, published 2025-09-12, deadline 2025-10-08 (A, verified by direct browse 2026-08-12). Includes the National Data Center, new ITMA headquarters and facilities for data-protection/cybersecurity agencies. Construction started March 2026 and local/UNDP reporting (per GW methodology baseline) planned completion July 2026 - implementation status B/C, capacity undisclosed so capacity_mw=null and status=construction until an official commissioning source appears. Aliases (one programme, no double count): National Technology Data Center Park = Centro Nacional de Dados = 'Data Center' da Guine-Bissau; ITMA HQ is part of the park. Cloud-region exclusion re-run 2026-08-12: no AWS/Azure/GCP/Oracle public region for GW; no verified commercial colocation provider; telco (Telecel/Orange/Guine-Telecom) network rooms are unverified data rooms, not facilities.

No datacenter facilities found in North division (Cacheu, Oio, Biombo) after division templates and connectivity queries (checked 2026-08-12). ACE is the only international submarine cable for Guinea-Bissau, landing at Suro/Suru in Cacheu region with a ~23-30 km terrestrial extension to the Antula power plant on the Bissau outskirts - a landing-station/connectivity lead (DC-adjacent), not a data centre (A- landing fact per ACE/TeleGeography; no DC claim).

No datacenter facilities found in East division (Bafata, Gabu) after division templates and queries ('Bafata Guinea-Bissau data center', 'Bafata OR Gabu centro de dados/data center/servidores', checked 2026-08-12; results were noise only). Per GW methodology, expected negative: backbone route and EAGB distribution points only.

No datacenter facilities found in South division (Quinara, Tombali, Bolama-Bijagos) after division templates and queries ('Quinara OR Tombali OR Bolama Guinea-Bissau centro de dados/data center', checked 2026-08-12; results were noise only). ITMA programme mentions interior/Bijagos digital benefits but no facility evidence, per GW methodology.
